en.summary: A dental abscess needs urgent dentist care and will not go away alone. ER if hard to breathe/speak/swallow, eye swelling/vision problems, lots of mouth swelling, or hard to open the mouth. GPs usually cannot provide dental treatment (NHS). No antibiotic self-start.
emergencyIf: Hard to breathe, speak or swallow
Swollen/painful eye or sudden eyesight problems
A lot of swelling in the mouth
seeDoctorIf: Think you have a dental abscess — urgent dentist / dental emergency pathway (not GP for dental treatment)
selfCare: Soft foods; soft toothbrush; avoid very hot/cold
OTC painkillers only as labeled — do not exceed dose
doNot: Do not expect it to resolve without dental care

fr.summary: Un abcès dentaire nécessite des soins dentaires urgents. Urgences si difficulté à respirer/parler/avaler, œil gonflé, gros gonflement buccal. Pas d'antibiotiques en automédication.
emergencyIf: Difficile de respirer, parler ou avaler
selfCare: Aliments mous ; antalgiques OTC selon notice

he.summary: מורסה דנטלית דורשת טיפול שיניים דחוף. חירום בקושי נשימה/דיבור/בליעה או נפיחות רבה בפה. אין אנטיביוטיקה עצמית.
selfCare: מזון רך; משככי כאבים לפי העלון

ru.summary: Зубной абсцесс требует срочной стоматологической помощи. Неотложка при затруднении дыхания/речи/глотания или сильном отёке рта. Антибиотики не начинать самостоятельно.
emergencyIf: Отёк/боль глаза или проблемы со зрением
seeDoctorIf: Подозрение на абсцесс — срочно к стоматологу
